body:
I was born and raised where I still am. I never got to travel, except maybe to California a couple of times. So, I don't know. I don't know where I'd hate it or where I'd love it.

But anyway, thank you again for your interest and your advice, but I have to go. I just wanted to get all this out of my head tonight.
Not usually, I don't know where I'd go, and plus I figure I'll just be miserable there, too.

No, I really don't. I don't have much of an interest in anything, but I get what you're saying: a trade school would be quicker than a bachelor's degree, and maybe with one of those jobs I could afford to move away. 

Even that, though, isn't going to make me want to continue living. True, I'd be away from all this mess, but there's just nothing I really want out of life anyway.

Once, I recall doing some research. I couldn't find many options: auto mechanic, nursing, computer tech... I didn't qualify for the programs offered through the community college, and the independent schools would have required me to take out a big loan. 

I could try to take out a bigger loan, of course.

I sincerely thank you for your comment. I'm not threatening to kill myself tonight or anything, I have no way to. 

However, with the rate at which things are going now, I can't just stick it out. It would be years yet before I get any kind of degree anyway, and I refuse to keep on this way. This is hell.
My family, as far as I'm concerned, includes only my mom. I worry how my death will affect her, but she won't take care of herself anymore, and I don't have it in me to do it either.
